newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Arab states call for a review of ties with Israel after a meeting of foreign ministers in Riyadh.

- Saudi agriculture and water minister says the kingdom spent 56 billion riyals on desalination projects. Saudi Arabia is considered the world's largest producer of desalinated water. It has 25 plants producing 700 million gallons daily.
- First group of Egyptian pilgrims arrive by sea for the annual haj at Islam's holiest shrine next month.
- Austrian finance and trade minister says big investment opportunities possible between Saudi Arabia and Austria.
- Auction by Mecca for Construction Company of housing projects in the kingdom is expected to generate 900 million riyals.
